productName: French Country 7 Drawer Dresser with Top Mirror
description:
Make a grand statement with the French Country 7 Drawer Dresser with Top Mirror from Old Time Oak. This impressive piece offers seven spacious dovetailed drawers for maximum storage, plus a beautiful framed mirror that adds elegance and functionality to your nursery.
Seven full-extension drawers provide generous space for your growing child's entire wardrobe, from newborn layettes through school-age clothing. The attached mirror is perfect for dressing and grooming as your child grows, making this a piece that serves the whole family for years. The solid wood construction with signature French Country detailing ensures heirloom-quality durability.
The dresser top accommodates a changing pad during the baby years, while the mirror adds depth and light to your nursery. Non-toxic, baby-safe finishes throughout. Coordinates with the full French Country collection including cribs, nightstands, and other dressers. Truly a piece that grows from nursery through the teenage years.
